title: Prague Crawl 2027: agenda
description: The day's running order, one row per session, in the Prague Crawl look (_prague-crawl/). Until the agenda is final, the times are placeholders and the order is a draft from the session types in scripts/deck/prague-crawl-2027.html (keynotes, talks and demos, lunch, lightning talks, the closing panel, the afterparty).
